title.label: I couldn’t manage without Due App

content.label: Really, I use it daily and probably hourly or more often. It’s my reminders and my adjunct to calendar. It sure does recurring reminders extremely well too

My ADHD causes me to forget a lot. Other reminder apps would remind me once…then I would forget again. Due keeps reminding me until I take care of it. I only put a few reminders in at a time or it would annoy me too often. I recommend it to everyone I talk to.

This should be the default, one and only reminders app for iOS. Intuitive, unique, and very well built. Anything I want/need to remember goes into Due, and Due will remind me periodically until I complete it. I have used due for years and it is ABSOLUTELY ESSENTIAL to how I function as a human being on Earth. I cannot say enough good about Due, it is truest one of the best apps in the App Store!
Love this app.  It nags me constantly and I  get my to-do lists done.

I’ve been using this reminders app for a very long time and I have to tell you something this is the best reminders app on the App Store it never fails it always remind you have to have to do.
Now they have change the user interface and it’s actually so much better it looks modern it looks really really great

This is my favorite app for Reminders! I really believe the best feature is the fact that I will keep reminding you until you snooze or reschedule the reminder. It is also very useful for setting reminders to cancel trial subscriptions!

I have had this app for years and I am happy to pay the subscription because the subscription is reasonable (looking at you Fantastical. $40/year for a calendar app). My disappointment is that (for me, my experience only here), syncing via iCloud is NOT working. My reminders sync, BUT when I mark a reminder as complete on my watch or iPhone it doesn’t sync to my iPad. It syncs to my iMac, but for some reason, never my iPad. I hope this can get fixed as I LOVE this app.
This is probably the most reliable, useful and essential app I have on my phone. It should come installed on iOS. Just download it now.

I really like the new calendar style date picker because it’s easier and faster to use. When using the scroll wheel before I would always have to correct the month when I accidentally touched it while scrolling the day so for me the calendar style is better!

I really like this app a lot. It’s very simple to use and love the reminders. However, I can’t figure out how to share my reminders with others which is a big problem.I will update this rating once I find a resolve.
Been using this since the first ver. must have.
I’m am a newbie to Due. It is very simple to use, quick to add to do’s or change them. I am glad I found this app.

I wish it would have a more colorful background and have a little box to check off. Also if you mute the notifications enough they stop appearing and I forget about what I was supposed to do so I wish it would continue sending notifications.

title.label: Love! Would be lost without Due

content.label: Perfectly complements my to-do app and calendar. I was tired of only getting one single notification for those little reminders that I didn’t even want on my to-do app or calendar. This app solves that plus more. I have integrated Due into my setup of Things and Fantastical. It really fits in nicely alongside a normal to-do app and calendar. HIGHLY recommend.
This is the best app it never misses a timed appointment .  Perfect!

title.label: I’m not subscribed- why am I suddenly being charge again?

content.label:
I already bought the app, I’m not subscribed- why am I suddenly being charge again?

Don’t get me wrong, I absolutely love this app and use it everyday, it helps with keeping on track, I’ve reviewed and raved about it on forms for productivity. But can a dev reach out to tell me why I’m being charged again? I originally bought it on Sept 16th, it’s Sept 27th and I have an additional $6.99 charge. Is there a secret subscription?

Great application! I use it everyday. I use OmniFocus everyday also, and this application is a terrific compliment to productivity apps. It's a good place to quickly plunk down tasks that need to be done right away but don't require contexts or categories. WORTH EVERY PENNY!

I have been using this app for years and I can’t imagine life without it. It keeps me organized and helps me to get things done. One thing I would love to see is a calendar integration where we could use due’s reminder system for meeting alerts. Very good app!

title.label: This app has saved my life

content.label: It helps me function like a normal human being. I highly recommend.

This app is what I have been looking for, I am loving it so far. If you could add a feature that would allow you to share the task with someone else (would then show in the Due app on their phone), that would be amazing.
I love this simple app. It’s perfect for setting and tracking reminders, if you don’t need to keep track of completions. It’s easy to set recurring reminders. Easy to postpone reminders. It’s great!

I use this app for everything from reminding myself to pay bills to reminding myself when to do certain household chores. So easy to use! I love that I can get the reminders on my Apple Watch too. Honestly, I would be lost without it.

title.label: Doesn’t have an easy way to have reminders BEFORE the event

content.label: This is a beautiful, intuitive app but unfortunately it doesn’t have an easy way to set up reminders before the event/task that is created. It has easy to set up alerts/reminders after the event/task but not before. A video i was offered to learn how to set up alerts before event/task but was not much help; the video is silent and doing what i saw done in the video didn’t work. Too bad the option to set up reminders before event/task is not easily available.

This app is my lifesaver, but right now, it’s glitching hard. Same alert keeps coming up over and over in a continuous loop. Can get the app to open. Tried turning phone off and back in twice, but that didn’t help. I need this app. Please squash this bug, quick!

title.label: No Sound If Phone Is On Silent

content.label: Been using this app for a couple weeks now and it is by far one of the very best reminder apps you’ll find. My only complaint is that reminders won’t play the selected sound if you have the phone on Silent Mode, which to be fair I understand but I leave my phone on Silent quite a bit but would like any scheduled reminders to still play their tune when they go off.

So far this looks good.  The one thing I’m disappointed not to see is an option to snooze for 24 hours.  Sometimes I need to run an errand or drop something off, and it is just not going to happen that day.  I need to be able to have it remind me the next day (and maybe the next) until I get it done
Maravillosa aplicación. Me encanta su modelo de suscripción 👍🏻👍🏻 Deberían agregar mas sonidos.

I’ve only been using this app for three days. But the past three days have been the most productive in months. I love the gentle alarms and the ability to have them remind me as often as I choose; without being overwhelmingly annoying. I’ve tried to create similar schedules/lists on my own in the past, but I’m usually instantly irritated by the alarm which hinders my desire to complete the task. Even when I’m doing nothing, I can’t stand interruptions, and this app provides such subtle, yet insistent reminders, it’s as if I want to please it, because it’s so “polite.” Seriously. I also really REALLY LOVE being able to pull the widget onto my home page, so I always know my next task at a glance. (I just discovered this was possible because of this app,) I’ve tried a few other apps in the past too, and this is the first one that I find myself responding to. 
It’s uncomplicated; which eases set up, and thereby does not frustrate me into “trying again later” as is usually the case. I love everything about this app so far! Thank you!!

The one thing an app like this cannot be is unreliable. Sadly, this app is incredibly unreliable. It sometimes skips reminding me of anything at all for days. Then, it will suddenly notify me of everything it’s failed to remind me of all at once. This makes the app worse than useless. It’s worthless and annoying. I recommend saving your money for an app that works.

Sync between devices is not working. It had worked before but no longer.  All sync settings including iCloud and background sync are on as recommended.
There is no way to contact Due developers for support. Zen desk does not address this problem.
Word to your mother.

title.label: Love the customizable widgets & theme switching

content.label: This app is the left side of my brain. I am a subscriber not only because it’s worth it, but because I want this excellent indie developer to keep on doing such a great job of maintaining, updating and improving this app. He is always coming up with more and more features, always useful improvements. This is my favorite 3d party Apple app ever. I truly appreciate the ongoing commitment to the quality of the user experience, not just the functionality. Just one of the reasons I love this app and hope never to have to live without it. And I love that can dictate Due reminders using Siri in the car, where I often think of things I still need to do (though I have to over-pronounce it like “Dyoo” so Siri will recognize it). Due is still hands-down the best money I ever spent in the App Store. The interactive notification snoozing is awesome too. This app offers a real and large difference and improvement over Apple’s Reminders, even now that Apple has added some very limited snoozing functionality. Due is the procrastinator’s best friend, and the cure-all for my stress- and age-induced ADD. Been using it since about a month after I got my first iPhone in 2010, and it will never leave my phone dock. Love, love, love, and NEED this app. Planning to look into the Mac version too after seeing all the additional things you can do. They should market it as a life-management app. That sums up what I use it for. A great complement to Apple’s Reminders app.

I have been using for many months (over a year?)
I use this daily for reminders of things to do as well as recurring reminders. Don’t know how I lived without it!!!!

I can’t believe that some people give negative reviews for this app just because it has a price tag attached to it. It’s just ridiculous. It’s only $5 bucks a year; less than $0.50 a month. Get it, it’s very worth it.
Super slick and easy to navigate. Takes seconds to remind yourself of daily stuff or long-term stuff. Very conscientious developer who seeks to update and improve the slickness. Love this App!

title.label: A must have for those with ADD/ADHD

content.label: I couldn’t function without this app! Definitely couldn’t get through PA school with out it

I use this app for quick things I want to get done, and then repeat it daily/weekly/monthly ~i.e. daily meds or weekly bathroom clean. For weekly bathroom clean, you could set it to repeat every Saturday at 9am no matter what. Or set it to repeat at exact time of completion such as exactly one week out from complete day. The swipe gesture to complete a task is so satisfying. Swipe it away, and next week it’ll be there again to remind us to clean bathroom. The postpone window is also quick and easy. Not ready to clean at 9am?! ~just let the reminder sit there if you want and all your reminders form a todo list. Or, you want to postpone it until 3pm so it’s farther down your list?! Click into it and quickly pick predefined times such as 3 PM or 6 PM or 9 PM. Much quicker gestures compared to all the other reminder apps. It’s so simple and elegant like I said it’s very satisfying to use.
I use this app dozens of times during the day. I could not get many repeating done on time without it. Love it!
Due is like my personal secretary. It keeps me from missing appointments and even reminds me to take my meds on time.  Thanks!
I get more things done and don’t forget to do things because of this app. I have found it to be incredibly helpful and smartly designed.

Timers and reminders are the best tools I have to cope with forgetfulness, time blindness, and competing priorities.

The persistent nature of Due reminders is better than any other reminder tool I’ve used. Highly recommended.
You’d be surprised the simplest things that’ll slip away without noticing so Due truly helps me accomplish them. Or at least remember them.

I am heavily dependent on reminders. If I don’t write something down, I will forget it. I’ve tried several reminder apps, and each one has been good but not great. This one is truly great. It gives you all the options you need, it’s aesthetically pleasing, and it’s just very well done. I feel very at ease putting all my reminders in this app.

It really works well. My only complaint is if you have nothing past due, the complication on Apple Watch just displays the word “due” 
If nothing is past due, I’d like it to display the next task in the future that is due. (That is why 4 stars, it that were fixed, it would be 5 stars).
Otherwise, really works great.
This is a really useful app and totally worth the price. At the age of 67 it’s given my brain a helping hand. My son is a construction superintendent and swears by it. Highly recommended.

I really like the constant reminder of the app. If this app had some more integration such as with Windows PC, business apps like Microsoft ToDo, Office etc. I would give it 5 stars. I spend my working hours in front of a computer so having to pull out my phone all the time to set a reminder is a pain. Also make it look like I’m not working. If you could add reminders from like a web page then the problem would be solved.

I purchased this app because the reviews made it seem as though it’s superior to iOS reminders. After spending over an hour trying to set an all-day reminder without a specific due time-of-day I emailed my question to customer support. Someone who goes by “JJ” basically called me a moron in so many words.

Update 2021:
Love it. Nice new feature just added that allows working with the reminder directly from the notification screen. 

Update 2020: I use Due every day. I have all of my repeating tasks in it and it bugs me until I do them. The new widget is great. You can adjust the color to be whatever you want, light or dark, independent of the system. This is my most used app. It is simple to use and keeps me reminded of the most important things I need to do every day. It has a nice design and some very clever ways to input and to view reminders.

I love this app. It’s one of the few apps that allows for “nagging,” which I need. It’s loaded with features, and besides the slightly older looking UI (I’m big on nice UIs), I can’t complain about anything else! Give this app a try!!!
I have been using this app for over five years, always meet my expectations.
